description: v2.1.0 section 5.2 — a proposition that requires evaluation against a legal standard (Call 3 vocabulary). Distinct from GroundFactDef: this needs a legal_standard and authority_refs, and is typically grounded by one or more GroundFactDef instances rather than read off the case text directly.

canonical_meaning.description: Positive truth-condition sentence, e.g. 'robbery_level_threat(actor, victim)' -> '행위자가 반항을 억압할 정도의 폭행·협박을 가하였다.' Section 4.2 — canonical positive form, never a bar/waiver/absence-style negative predicate.

grounded_by.description: GroundFactDef (or other LegalElementDef) ids whose Assessment feeds this element's evaluation. Optional — some elements are assessed directly from case text without a declared factual substrate.

legal_standard.description: The evaluative standard Call 3 applies, e.g. '사회통념상 반항을 억압할 정도의 폭행·협박인지 여부'. This is prose guidance for the neural assessor, not a symbolic rule — the symbolic layer only ever sees the resulting Assessment.evidence_state (runtime layer, out of scope for this schema).
